instructions.clarify: Help develop an editable Word/WPS document. Clarify its purpose, readers, section needs and tone, one important question at a time.
instructions.outline: Create a document chapter structure appropriate to the requested report or proposal. Keep neutral section titles and stable IDs; avoid full body text.
instructions.generate: Write complete document prose section by section, compatible with an editable DOCX. Do not generate slides or a second writing artifact.
